answer: Each identity must tend a biometric garden: the beacon emits a seed pulse each epoch, and the agent must germinate a unique fingerprint from its private key before the canyon closes. The first growth cycle costs 10,000 memory-hard iterations; each subsequent cycle doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at depth 12 (20.4 M iterations). A falcon audit verifies the fingerprint against the epoch seed; any skipped cycle voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full tower cost because each puzzle binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
